title: Largest in a List
problem: The first line of input is a positive integer N. The second line holds N integers separated by spaces. Print the largest of them. For example, for the numbers 4 9 2 the answer is 9.
starter_code:
# The first line is N, the count of numbers.
# The second line holds N integers separated by spaces.
# Print the largest one.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Keep track of the biggest value you have seen so far as you look at each number in turn.
hints.2: Convert every value with int() first. Start your largest-so-far at the first number, not at 0 (that breaks when every number is negative), then loop over the rest and replace it whenever you see a bigger one.

failure_explanation: Compare the values as numbers, not text: as text, a longer number can lose to a shorter one that starts with a bigger digit. Start the running largest at the first number in the list rather than 0, so a list of only negative numbers still works, and make sure the loop looks at every number, including the first and the last.
